spans.text: ...At the entrance to Hell.
Where is this? Where am I?
Where's Little Snake? Where's NZ?
The sky is familiar, the trees are familiar, the air is familiar...
All this tells Jashin-chan that she has returned home.
I'm back? Ahahahaha, I'm back!
I don't know how it happened, but I'm free at last!!!
Ahahahaha, I'm freeeeeeeee!!!
Jashin-chan runs across the fields of Hell...
...Several minutes earlier, in Yurine's apartment.
After pulling back the rug to clean the place, Yurine immediately discovers the magic circle Jashin-chan has left behind.
No wonder she fessed up so quickly, she had a backup plan.
Yurine smiles coldly and prepares to erase the magic circle.
Ding dong— Someone rings the doorbell.
One second, please.
Medusa, why are you crying?
I... (Sobs)
Medusa tells Yurine everything that happened at the gachapon store.
There there, Medusa. When Jashin-chan comes back, I'll be sure to teach her a lesson for you.
(Sobs) Don't-don't hit her...
Jashin-chan keeps bullying you because you're always too kind.
(Sobs)
Ding dong— Someone rings the doorbell again.
A moment, please.
Uh... I heard that tonight...
Oh, it's Pekola. What are you doing here all of a sudden?
Jashin-chan said there would be beef hotpot tonight... She invited Pekola to have some too...
Hm? Jashin-chan never told me anything like that.
Still, you can come in and have a seat, Pekola.
Pekola stiffly sits down opposite Medusa and Yurine.
Yurine pours a big mug of barley tea for Pekola.
Pekola, where did you see Jashin-chan?
I saw her in front of my tent, Pekola's tent was destroyed and Jashin-chan said that a bull-headed monster did it.
A bull-headed monster...
Could she be talking about Minos...?
(Bam bam bam) A series of forceful raps come from the door.
Coming—
The door opens and a furious Minos storms in.
Dammit, that Jashin-chan makes me so mad—
What happened, Minos?
What happened to your tail...?
Minos narrates the story of her encounter with Jashin-chan and how the latter became the subject of her fury.
Jashin-chan's lies are getting more and more ridiculous.
How could this be...
I can't take it anymore.
Yurine stands up.
I'm going to find Jashin-chan and settle things with her right now.
Calm down, Yurine!
Good, we'll go together!
A-Are we going?
The four of them head outside. In unison, they step over the rug which conceals a secret.
The magic circle beneath it lights up with a familiar radiance...
Ehhhhhhh?!
It's Jashin-chan's—!
The light fades, and the four girls disappear into the air.
...On the streets of Jinbocho.
Jashin-chan, who was at the peak of her triumph just moments ago, now resembles a three-day-old dried herring as she trudges tiredly through Jinbocho.
I feel so empty...
This is great news, but I've got nobody to enjoy it with...
Is Bête the only one I can celebrate my newfound freedom with?
Congratulations, Jashin-chan.
Ack! Don't just appear out of nowhere!
Also, it isn't time for an episode recap yet, is it?!
Oh, I'm not here as Recap or as a narrator. Right now, I am simply Tangan-chan the delivery demon.
How many part-time jobs are you working at the same time?!

Here's the deal. Since you managed to take out so many of the main characters of "Jashin-chan's Frontline" all by yourself, you are now officially the number one character as decreed by the powers that be.
Congratulations!
...I don't feel very happy.
As a reward, we've specially unlocked hidden plot scenes for you!
Can I skip them?
Sure!
Now, let's watch the hidden scenes that have been unlocked for the first time!
You're just ignoring me now!
...Outside the gachapon store.
Jashin-chan, wait for me!
Medusa, who has been sprinting the whole way, suddenly screeches to a halt right outside the gachapon store.
Has she forgotten something? Or has she suddenly changed her mind about saving Jashin-chan?
In this moment of suspense...
Medusa starts tidying up her dress, which has been ripped by tree branches, and hides the bruises and scrapes that cover her legs.
Medusa sustained these injuries when she fell while taking a shortcut on her way down the mountain. Looks like it was a pretty bad fall...
Tangan-chan, your narration is too loud...
Pardon me, Miss Medusa. I forgot to switch over to the narration channel...
It's fine.
Medusa adjusts her dress, concealing her cuts and bruises.
Noticing Tangan-chan's questioning gaze, Medusa smiles and explains herself.
In the past, it was always Jashin-chan who came running to save me.
Whether it was being bullied by my classmates or being swindled by a shady storekeeper, Jashin-chan was always the first to rush to my rescue.
Now that I finally have the chance to rescue Jashin-chan, I don't want to make a lame entrance.
But what if Jashin-chan is lying?
Even if she's lying to me, I have to go to her side and be with her anyway.
Because she's my friend, after all.
Medusa smiles and waves Tangan-chan goodbye before entering the gachapon store...
...At the entrance to the park.
Minos exits the park, in low spirits after having a big handful of her tail fur pulled out.
As everyone in Hell knows, the only thing Minotaurs value as much as the horns on their heads is the fur on their tails.
Anyone with a sleek coat of glossy tail fur—
Tangan-chan, you're being annoying.
Eh?! How could I have forgotten to switch channels again!
Minos is feeling too down to contest the point.
Miss Minos, are you mad at Jashin-chan?
No, it's perfectly normal for friends to scuffle with each other...

When I was young, I accidentally launched Jashin-chan into the sky when pushing her on the swing, I broke her spine by accident when we were playing house, I broke her tail when punching a sandbag... That sort of thing.
I just...really hate being lied to.
Miss Minos...
I'll forgive her, of course.
But not until we fight it out properly.
Hm?
Just my luck that we're friends. No matter how much we disagree, once we have a good fight it'll all be water under the bridge.
Just you wait, Jashin-chan!
I won't let you off so easily this time...
Minos continues muttering to herself as she heads toward Yurine's apartment. Her bald tail slowly perks up, rising proudly once again like a flag in the wind...
Jashin-chan's hand slowly presses on her belly...
So you made up the headcount for activating the magic circle...
And that was just a part of the hidden scenes!
That's enough...
Of course, I know you haven't had enough, so—
Let's move on to the rest of the hidden scenes!
The next one features Pekola—
That's enough! I don't want to see any more!
Jashin-chan shoves Tangan-chan aside and runs down the other side of the street...
After walking for who knows how long, a newly-opened convenience store draws Jashin-chan's attention.
A convenience store... There used to be a bookstore here.
Yurine used to come here often.
Jashin-chan, come look, the shopkeeper just brought in these books.
Yu-Yurine!
You're worrying too much. These books won't be enough to collapse the floor at home.
Yurine...
Jashin-chan reaches out to her. Her fingers pass through Yurine's face and make contact with the cold glass of the convenience store window.
By the time she comes to her senses, Yurine is gone.
Haha...
How could Yurine be here...
Jashin-chan silently walks down the streets.
The bustling crowds brushing past her seem like specters from another world.
We've got a promotion for you!
40% off all lunch sets! They're all going for just 60%!
Huh? This curry place has long queues every time I come here...
To think they'd offer discounts too!
It's time for lunch. You want curry, right?
Here we go again...
Let's stand in line and wait, then. Besides, it's not like we have anything important to do later.
You want their signature roast potatoes? Sure, I want them too.
Is that you, Yurine...?
Yurine vanishes into thin air once again, leaving a confused shop assistant looking uncertainly at Jashin-chan.
Uh... Would you like to come in?
Though I'm afraid our signature potatoes are all sold out...
Pain washes over her gut like a flood and Jashin-chan shakes her head before leaving.
I should be happy...
So why...
Jashin-chan lowers her head and joins the crowd, like a withered leaf falling from a branch into the mud.
Ugh... What am I doing here?
NZ, P90, where's Ouroboros?
Seeing how quickly the tables have turned against her, Ouroboros decides to beat a hasty retreat.
Oh no you don't!
NZ75 rushes forward and blocks Ouroboros' path.
So, Ouroboros, what did you do to me at the gachapon store?
I was in a warehouse just now...
You'd better come clean about your plan!
...Dammit.
Is it because the stupid snake has vanished? Her spell has lost its effect...
Ouroboros, what are the two of you plotting?
Humph, I just wanted to send you three troublemakers back to Griffin.
Then you could have just TOLD us.
I mean, which of us wouldn't want to go back to the base?
No, she's planning to stay behind by herself.
But why?
Does it matter?
It's not like Griffin needs a problematic Doll like me anyway. The combat sims have sucked out whatever value I had.
You say you're a problematic Doll? Okay, can anyone here say that they don't have problems of their own?
Not me!
Me neither!
The Griffin base is filled with your so-called "problematic Dolls". But the Commander has brought us together and given us the opportunity to make use of our strengths.
Griffin is the amalgamation of imperfect Dolls like us.
The reference material for the neural calibration exam is filled with long screeds like what you just said, I'm sick of hearing them.
I just don't get it. What's wrong with just sticking to my plan and going back to the Griffin base...?
But we're a team now! As if we would abandon a teammate and go back without you!
Yup!
Even Sangvis Ferri won't easily abandon their friends, right?
Sangvis Dolls have never been emotionless killing machines.
Especially the innovative designs like Hunter and Executioner. Being able to help each other means they can stay alive longer on the battlefield.
That's why she saved Hunter instead.
How do you know all this? You even know more about the priority of Sangvis authority than I do...
I don't, actually. I simply gambled on it.
Perhaps...this is Agent's insurance for keeping you in check.
I'm back.
Jashin-chan suddenly appears behind the others. She is clearly on her last legs.
Uwah, you scared the crap out of me!
Where the hell did you go, you stupid snake?!
Jashin-chan suddenly collapses...
Hey! This isn't the time to show off your acting skills!
Wait, NZ, something's wrong with Jashin-chan...
Quit playing dead already!
(Groans)
My stomach hurts...
Jashin-chan collapses to the ground and her tail convulses into twisted coil.
Her hands are pressed tightly over her belly and groans of pain escape from between her gritted teeth.
My stress-induced gastritis...is flaring up...
It...hurts...
Quit standing around, call the ambulance!
I'll use that phone booth over there!
I-I'll go to the pharmacy and see what they can do!
NZ75 and P90 run off in separate directions, leaving Ouroboros and CZ75 with Jashin-chan.
CZ75 props Jashin-chan's head against NZ75's book bag.
Is this better?
What's this? It's so hard...
Jashin-chan reaches into the bag to pull out the offending object, and through her teary eyes, she makes out what CZ75 has stuffed under her neck.
It is Volume II of the Grimoire.
The book which contains the return spell.
Hahaha...
This is...
I... Hahaha...
I did something incredibly stupid...
Look on the bright side, since when have you NOT done something incredibly stupid?
I want to hurl...
Little Snake...
What?
Could you...hold my hand...?
Whenever this happened to me, Yurine would hold my hand like this and it wouldn't hurt so much anymore...
I'll kill you if you puke on my hand.
Yurine...and the others... They're all gone...
Wasn't that part of our plan?
I thought I would be happy...
But I'm not. In fact, I feel downright miserable...
Why is that, Little Snake?
Why is this world nothing like what I imagined...
Because this world is a pile of dog turds.
The funny thing is that I fought for it with everything I had.
I fought over a thousand AIs and suffered great humiliation at the hands of that bastard, all to come to a world like this.
Because I want you to see the world outside, Little Snake.
I want to see your wretched face...
...When you finally find something out there that's actually worth giving your life for...
Heh, my face IS pretty damn wretched right now.
Don't say that...
Isn't it?
Urgh... It hurts...
Jashin-chan's freezing hand trembles in Ouroboros' grasp.
Are you just going to give up like this? What about the Jashin-chan Empire you were going to build?
Give me a break... I'm in pain here...
Jashin-chan tries to pull her hand away from Ouroboros' grasp, but the latter refuses to let go.
What are you doing, Ouroboros?!
She's in pain, don't force her anymore...
CZ75 walks up to Jashin-chan, intending to remove her from Ouroboros' grasp.
However, Ouroboros clings to Jashin-chan for dear life.
Hey, stupid snake.
Lend me your power.
...What?
Fulfil your promise and build the ideal world we wished for.
Let go, Ouroboros!
The food there will never go bad, our parts will never wear out, and motor oil will always be in ample supply...
We can get anything we want, and all the people we hate will be gone...
Everything will remain at its most perfect moment...
Give me your strength. Let us take back everything we've lost, in a different way.
Jashin-chan doesn't say anything, but Ouroboros can feel a tremendous power flow into her through Jashin-chan's hand.
What...is this...
Come, let us welcome a brave new world.
Hello? Anybody there?
Uh... Why was all my screentime cut? You could at least have informed me, you know?!
Also, nobody said anything about this job involving suuuuper long-distance travel to another world!
I charge extra for that! Hello? Is anyone there?
Aw man, I've been on-air the whole time...?
Ahem, previously on "Jashin-chan's Frontline", Jashin-chan's plan finally succeeded, but she wasn't really happy about it.
In order to take back what she lost, Jashin-chan and Ouroboros from the other world have joined hands to create their ideal world.
Meanwhile, Yurine and co. have been transported to a place called the Griffin Base—
Sorry, but my long-haul bus has arrived, so just sit back and enjoy the show!
...In the Commander's office.
The volume on the Commander's TV has been turned all the way down, and the people standing with their backs to the TV are equally silent.
Well, we have no other choice now.
But—
Fire up the magic circle again. According to what you said, if CZ and the others are still at their original location, we'll be able to teleport them back.
Theoretically, that should be the case.
Given Ouroboros' personality, she'll stay put as long as there's no immediate danger.
Give it a try, K5. Might as well do it here.
Understood.
K5 redraws the magic circle as shown in the book.
Is that it?
Um, actually, we need—
The magic circle shines with blinding light.
Are they back?
That was fast!
Uwahhhhh—
O Lord, save us!!!
Four unfamiliar girls appear in the middle of the summoning circle.
Eh?!
Wait, isn't this from the episode I'm watching right now...?
Who are you? Where are CZ75 and the others?!
You tell me!
Who are you, and why have you brought us here?
This doesn't look like Heaven, it looks more like a nest of demons...
She-she has horns...
Could she be...
What is...this place...?
Oh no! That's a human!
Upon seeing the Commander, the purple-haired girl immediately stuffs her head into a brown paper bag.
This is the Griffin Base, and I am the Commander here.
I apologize for this. We were going to summon our missing Dolls, but we ended up summoning you instead...
Missing Dolls? Do you mean...
CZ75, NZ75, P90, and—
Ouroboros.
I knew it...
Aren't they the people hanging around Jashin-chan?
So this is the world they came from.
Do you know where they are now?
...And that's basically what happened.
They ought to be with Jashin-chan now, so they shouldn't be in any danger.
So what you said about a portal that directly links two worlds is true, Miss Yurine?
Yes, I've been reading through magical tomes the entire afternoon and found that this solution is the simplest, though it is also somewhat draining.
Yurine is amazing!
Well, that's won—
Commander! Bad news!
What is it, Kalin?
The big storm is here! The contamination index around the base is spiking!
And it's brought tons of ELIDs with it...
Understood. Dispatch our teams immediately.
What great timing.
You seem to be having some kind of trouble.
What are ELIDs?
Um, they're kind of like zombies, like in the movies...
Did you say zombies?
Yurine's eyes gleam with excitement.
In that case, I insist on helping out.
